facts.text: Woodbury University requires internships for all undergraduate majors so that students apply their learning with hands-on professional experience.

sources.title: Why URLA? - Woodbury University
sources.quote: Internships are required for all our majors which means you'll apply your learning with hands on experience and boost your resume.
